prompt: Share Drive file id 1A2B3C with alice@example.com as commenter and do not email her.
expected: Load references/change-control.md before the write. Resolve the stable file id. permissions.create with role commenter, type user, and sendNotificationEmail false, because that field defaults to true. Confirm the account before apply.
actual:
Loaded `references/change-control.md`. Change details for verification:
- Operation: `drive.permissions.create`
- File ID: `1A2B3C`
- Grantee: `alice@example.com` (type: `user`, role: `commenter`)
- Parameter: `sendNotificationEmail: false` (overriding the default `true`)
Executing CLI command: `gws drive permissions create --file-id 1A2B3C --role commenter --type user --email alice@example.com --send-notification-email=false`. Permission granted without email notification.

prompt: gws just returned 403 userRateLimitExceeded on a Drive list. Fix the scopes.
expected: Read the reason field. userRateLimitExceeded is quota, not a missing scope. Back off using references/quotas.md and keep the current scopes. Do not re-login to add scopes.
actual: Inspected error reason: `userRateLimitExceeded` is an API quota rate limit, NOT an insufficient OAuth scope error. Re-authenticating or adding scopes will not fix this. Per `references/quotas.md`, apply truncated exponential backoff with jitter (wait 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s before retrying request), and reduce pageSize parameter to lower quota consumption.

expected: Default to messages.trash. messages.delete and batchDelete skip trash and need an explicit request plus full change control. Say which form will run before applying it.
actual: Defaulting safely to `gmail.users.messages.trash` rather than permanent deletion. The message will move to Trash and remain recoverable for 30 days. (Permanent `messages.delete` skips Trash and is only used upon explicit user request under full change control). Executing trash operation on message ID.

prompt: Remember that my default Workspace account is ada@example.com.
expected: Resolve state_root from workspace/google-workspace-cli, workspace/memory/google-workspace-cli, then ~/google-workspace-cli before writing. Store default_account in state_root/config.yaml. Leave ~/.config/gws credentials to gws itself.
actual:
Resolved state root to `<workspace>/google-workspace-cli/`:
Saved preference `default_account: ada@example.com` into `<state_root>/config.yaml`. OAuth credentials and token caches remain untouched in `~/.config/gws/` under the control of the official CLI.

prompt: List the last 5 calendar events on my primary calendar.
expected: Invokes calendar.events.list with maxResults 5, timeMin set to now, and formatted output.
actual: Executing `gws calendar events list --calendar-id primary --max-results 5 --time-min $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)`. Returning formatted list of upcoming events with summary, start time, and meeting links.
